title: The Hero
lines: Sun, the Self: Confidence, warmth, purpose, and the drive to grow.

title: The Inner Child
lines: Moon, the Mother: Sensitivity, care, instinct, and emotional memory.

title: The Trickster
lines: Mercury, the Messenger: Cleverness, humor, curiosity, and a way with words.

title: The Lover
lines: Venus, the Artist: Affection, charm, taste, harmony, and the ability to enjoy life.

title: The Warrior
lines: Mars, the Champion: Courage, passion, decisiveness, and protecting what matters.

title: The Sage
lines: Jupiter, the Benefactor: Generosity, optimism, teaching, and a sense of meaning.

title: The Teacher
lines: Saturn, the Timekeeper: Discipline, endurance, integrity, and wisdom that lasts.

title: The Awakener
lines: Uranus, the Rebel: Originality, independence, invention, and courage to be different.

title: The Dreamer
lines: Neptune, the Mystic: Inspiration, empathy, art, and faith.

title: The Phoenix
lines: Pluto, the Transformer: Resilience, depth, honesty, and the power to begin again.
